title: Kalaam : Ustaad e Mohtaram Janaab Dawar Ali Dawar Sahab
body:
Ya Abul Fazlil Abbas(a.s) Ya Abul Fazlil Abbas(a.s)
Ya Moula Abbas(a.s) Ya Moula Abbas(a.s)
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Aap ke parcham ka saaya jisko bhi miljayega
wo Hussaini matamdaar duniya me kehlayega
Aap ke har matam me aakar roti'n hai Zehra(s.a)
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Nazro'n par lashkar ko roka teen din ki pyaas me
Darya se waapas hai aaya teen din ki pyaas me
moujei'n sar ko takraati hain pyaasa hai darya
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Khainch ke teero'n ko seene se shumr chadha tha seene par
Yaad jo bhai ki aati thi rote jaate the Sarwar(a.s)
chalta tha khanjar to kehta jaata tha pyaasa
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Beti Zehra(s.a) ki bechaadar aati'n hai bazaar me
chadar lekar aao bhai jaana hai darbaar me
uryaa'n sar darbaar me kaise jayegi dukhiya
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zainab(s.a) ko dharas thi tumse aye Ghazi Abbas(a.s)
Sarwar ke baccho'n ki dawar toote dil ki aas
Ahle haram ki har chadar ka ek hi tha nouha
<<MINI>>
Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s) Abbas(a.s)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Ustaad e Mohtaram Janaab Dawar Ali Dawar Sahab
